surveyIntro: A short anonymous survey about how it feels to work here. Results are only ever shown aggregated by team.
q1: How likely are you to recommend this company as a place to work?
q2: I understand what is expected of me in my role.
q3: I receive the support I need from my manager.
q4: I feel safe raising concerns or suggesting improvements.
q5: My current workload is manageable over the long term.

commentPrompt.low: What is the most important thing we should improve?
commentPrompt.mid: What would improve your experience by one point?
commentPrompt.high: What should we make sure to preserve?
commentPrompt.default: Anything else you'd like to share?

anonymityNote: Please don't include names or personally identifying details — comments are shown anonymized.
noOpenSurvey: There is no pulse survey open right now.
notParticipant: You are not a participant of the current pulse cycle.
editableUntil: Your answers are saved. You can edit them until {{date}}.

validation.commentTooLong: The comment must be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.closeDateInvalid: The close date must be after the open date.

error.submitForbidden: You may not submit this survey.
error.submitConflict: The survey is no longer open.
error.invalid: The request was rejected — check the form and try again.
error.conflict: The action conflicts with the cycle's current state.

results.question: Question
results.notEnoughResponses: Fewer than 3 responses — results are hidden to protect anonymity.
results.resultsGated: Results are available for closed cycles you took part in.
results.noTeams: No teams to show results for.
results.trendPending: The trend appears after two closed cycles.
results.commentsAnonymized: Shown anonymized and in random order.

participation.hint: Who of your reports has submitted the survey — never their answers.
participation.noCycle: No open or closed cycle to monitor.

admin.title: Pulse cycles
admin.settingsHint: Used to prefill the scheduling form — opening and closing stay manual.
admin.scheduleHint: Scheduling notifies everyone eligible; the survey link goes out when you open the cycle.
